name: Owl’s Wisdom, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, medium 4, paladin 4, psychic 5, ranger 4, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

Duration 10 min./2 levels

This spell functions as owl’s wisdom, except it grants an enhancement bonus to Wisdom equal to 1/2 your caster level.
